neighbours.label: a surface or space being filled or covered by a mass (covered with ice, encrusted in snow, a packed crowd), as against the same scenes without a covering mass
fire: By January the entire pond was coated in thick ice.
The cars in the lot were buried under a layer of snow.
As the gates opened, the crowd surged toward the stage.
The mountain road is covered with snow for half the year.
Long before kickoff the crowd filled every seat in the stands.
The ship's deck was crusted with ice after the storm.
When the singer appeared, the crowd erupted in cheers.
Each winter the northern bay is covered in sea ice.
quiet: By January the entire pond was drained for repairs.
The cars in the lot were washed by a team of students.
As the gates opened, the guard walked toward the stage.
The mountain road is closed to trucks for half the year.
Long before kickoff the coach checked every seat in the stands.
The ship's deck was painted grey after the storm.
When the singer appeared, the pianist smiled at her.
Each winter the northern bay is mapped by researchers.
